versions.changelog: Normalize escaped newlines in copy before publishing, and make the default Xiaohongshu copy style natural/human by disabling catchphrase-heavy persona quirks unless explicitly requested.
Formalize Xiaohongshu video publish flow: upload via input.upload-input, wait for real editor signals, fill title/body before publish, and document local-browser draft behavior.
Add creator-platform QR login flow; SMS login now surfaces QR_REQUIRED when Xiaohongshu forces app scan; update docs and runtime rules for QR-first fallback.
Fix: improve login robustness (QR and SMS), tolerant visibility selector, schedule support; bug fixes and packaging.
Rename to luan-xhs-skill; improve Xiaohongshu web publishing flow; add SMS login, auto text cover, visibility control, and scheduled publish support.
